data.name: Carbon Removal Canada
data.description: Carbon Removal Canada is an independent policy advocacy initiative, a project of the Clean Prosperity Foundation, focused on scaling carbon dioxide removal in Canada. It engages with policymakers and stakeholders to advance CDR-supportive policies, procurement programs, and protocols (DAC, biochar, BECCS, mineralization, enhanced weathering, ocean alkalinity enhancement). It does not itself remove CO2 but is part of the CDR ecosystem.
